reviews.summary: Live stats.json has the new bands for AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and the sums equal the counts. The home line (30 of 563) matches gt_32k, llms.txt mentions the bands, data_delayed is false and the suite passes.

There were no offenders, so no code changed. The existing tests/test_trailing_slash.py guards the criterion, and the whole suite passes with 0 offenders over 72484 refs. The slash-less /lang/php and /lang/python requests have no internal source.
The live sitemap has 1935 URLs, each with a lastmod, and the three sample pages have self-canonicals. The whole suite passed (124 tests) and build.json shows data_delayed false.

Both new paths are tracked as directory presence checks. stats.json shows tracked_since null, the home history table shows 'not tracked', and llms.txt lists them. The offline test covers the baseline case and the whole suite passed.
README, tests and live pages agree on 12 paths. The scan-time estimate is stated as a formula, and build.json shows data_delayed false.

The README no longer states a test-file count, and a new offline test fails if it states one that differs from the number of tests/test_*.py files. The dispatcher's full run passed (131 tests, exit 0), and live build.json shows data_delayed false.

The live home page, /lang/php/, stats.json and llms.txt all show the two unmeasured paths as 'Not measured yet' or null with measured:false. Measured paths keep their values and show a date and repos-checked count, and the dispatcher's suite passed (133 tests, OK).
Unmeasured paths now show as not measured on cards, card index.json and /lang/ tables, and llms.txt explains it. The tests exist and passed in the dispatcher run; build.json shows data_delayed false.

The 3b1b/manim card now says "none of the 10 checked file paths" and lists the two unmeasured paths in a separate "Not measured yet" clause. The two card-summary tests exist and the dispatcher's whole-suite run passed, and build.json shows data_delayed false.

Tables are wrapped in div.scroll.table-wrap, the viewport meta is present, and the CSS has overflow-x:auto with no width above 375px on body, main or table. The new test passes in the dispatcher's whole-suite run, and build.json shows data_delayed false.

- **/go/ 17.11:** 3 875 запросов, из них 3 848 краулеры (meta-externalagent). Человеческих источников 0.
